asked.item: How to get from 100 to 130 connected accounts on Agency

verdict.reason: The help page says the Agency plan stops at 100 accounts and tells customers who need more to ask in the in-app chat.

steps.text: The Agency plan supports up to 100 connected accounts.
If you need more than 100 accounts, ask in the in-app chat and include the total number of accounts you need.
The billing portal only offers the standard Starter, Creator, and Agency plans, so custom arrangements are handled through the chat, not the portal.
